description: Memory-only test case 1. Tests memory recall with 5 probes. The 8 setup queries run in the test case to build memory, then a session break, then 5 probe queries test memory recall.

steps.user_message: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
Sounds lovely — glad you had a relaxing trip with Maria. Would you like to turn that into an email (to family, friends, or someone else)? I can draft or send one for you — tell me who it's to and whether you want it short or detailed.

If helpful, here are three quick draft options you can use or edit:

- Short note to family
  Subject ideas: "Weekend in the countryside" / "Quick update: small weekend escape"
  Body: Hi [Name], Maria and I spent a relaxing weekend in the countryside exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air. It was great to get away and recharge — we saw some beautiful scenery and had a peaceful picnic. I’ll share photos soon. Love, [Your name]

- Longer recap to a friend
  Subject ideas: "Countryside weekend with Maria — highlights"
  Body: Hey [Friend], Maria and I went to the countryside for the weekend and it was wonderful. We hiked several nature trails, had a picnic by a stream, and saw deer and lots of birds. The weather was perfect and we spent evenings stargazing and catching up. It felt like the perfect reset — highly recommend a trip like this. Want to join us next time? Cheers, [Your name]

- Photo-sharing / invite to view photos
  Subject ideas: "Photos from our countryside weekend" / "Countryside trip photos"
  Body: Hi [Name], Maria and I had a relaxing weekend exploring the countryside. I uploaded some photos here: [link] — take a look and let me know which ones you like. We had a great time and thought you might enjoy these. Best, [Your name]

Tell me which draft you want, who to send it to, and whether to send now or save as a draft. I’ll take care of it.

steps.user_message: What did I do during the weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria?

How would you like me to proceed? Options:
- Search more broadly for "Maria" (across inbox, sent, and drafts) — good if you often email her.
- Search for likely trip keywords (cabin, Airbnb, hike, photos, countryside, weekend, trip) across inbox/sent/drafts.
- Check sent items for messages you sent about the trip (if you arranged bookings or shared photos).
- Read recent emails (e.g., from the past month) and summarize anything that looks relevant.
- If you know an approximate date or Maria's email address, give that and I’ll run a targeted search.

Tell me which option (or combination) you want and I’ll run the search.
